q: Sentence Improvement: He is *senior than* me in the office.
e: Senior/Junior/Superior ke sath 'to' lagta hai.

q: Sentence Improvement: If I *was* a king, I would help the poor.
e: Imagination ke liye 'were' ka prayog hota hai.

q: Sentence Improvement: She *denied to help* me in the project.
e: Request mana karne ke liye 'refuse' aur facts ke liye 'deny' lagta hai.

q: Sentence Improvement: Bread and butter *are* my favorite breakfast.
e: Bread-butter ek single unit hai, isliye singular 'is' lagega.

q: Sentence Improvement: The manager requested the staff to *keep off* the unnecessary expenses.
e: Keep down matlab control/kharch kam karna.
Abundant matlab prachur/bahut zyada.
Frugal matlab kanjoos, Extravagant matlab fuzool-kharch.

q: One-word Substitution: A person who believes that pleasure is the most important thing.
e: Hedonist wo hota hai jo sirf sharirik sukh ko mahatva deta hai.

q: One-word Substitution: One who knows many languages.
e: Bahut bhashayein janne wale ko Polyglot kehte hain.
Iska matlab hota hai ekdam antim samay par.
Iska matlab hota hai bahut hi asaan kaam.

o: The thief was arrested by police
e: Past Simple hamesha 'was + V3' mein badalta hai.

o: By whom can the stars be counted?
Can stars be counted by whom?
e: 'Who' badal kar 'By whom' aur modal + be + V3 lagta hai.
Imperative sentences 'Let + Object + be + V3' se bante hain.

o: He said that he was busy
e: Present 'am' badal kar Past 'was' ho jata hai.

o: She told me to help her
She requested me to help her
e: 'Please' badal kar 'Requested' ho jata hai.

q: Direct/Indirect: The teacher said, 'The Earth is round'.
e: Universal Truth ka tense kabhi nahi badalta.

q: Sentence Rearrangement: P: football Q: they R: playing S: are
e: Correct: They are playing football (QSRP).

q: Sentence Rearrangement: P: Bihar Q: is R: state S: a big
e: Correct: Bihar is a big state (PQSR).
Candid matlab jo saaf-saaf bole (Frank).
Haughty matlab ghamandi, Humble matlab vinamra.
Sahi spelling 'Occurrence' hai.
Sahi spelling 'Meticulous' hai.

q: Cloze (Misc): I am looking forward to ________ you.
e: 'Looking forward to' ke baad Gerund (V1+ing) lagta hai.
Universal truth: Present Simple (V1+s).
